newsitem.title: NORWAY: First template ready for N. Sea Gullfaks satellite.
newsitem.headline: First template ready for N. Sea Gullfaks satellite.

text.p: The first seabed installation for the North Sea Gullfaks satellites -- Gullfaks South, Rimfaks and Gullveig -- is ready for delivery, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (STATOIL) ) said on Thursday.
Weighing around 100 tonnes, the unit is due to leave the fabrication yard at Langesund in Southeast Norway next week and be shipped to the Coast Centre Base outside of Bergen on the west coast.
The template was developed by Kongsberg Offshore (KOS) in cooperation with Statoil.
From Bergen it will be transferred to Transocean Wildcat for transport to the field and installation. The first of four production wells in the template can be spudded as soon as it is in position.
KOS is due to supply eight subsea templates to the satellite projects -- four on Gullfaks South, three on Rimfaks and one for Gullveig.
The units will be installed when completed and delivered, with drilling due to continue until 2000. Production is scheduled to begin in October 1998 from 12 of the 23 planned wells.
